ai_summary.key_headline: Arnold's Lions of Mesopotamia Target a Haaland Containment Plan

iraq.philosophy: Disciplined, defensively organized mid-block with a focal-point target man.

norway.philosophy: Aggressive high press with direct vertical balls into Haaland's central runs.

tactical_insights: On their first World Cup since 1986, Iraq will use a double-pivot screen to restrict service to Erling Haaland.
Norway's wings will overlap and cross frequently to exploit Iraq's height disadvantage in defense.
Ali Jasim's pace on the counter will be Iraq's primary outlet to bypass Norway's high defensive line.
